scope: Typed file metadata queries, host/phone clarification-choice transport and a real native WK visible-file-input handoff. No model inference or actual file upload.

verifiedComponents.catalog: 9 focused tests pass; full bounded inventory filters/sorts before pagination; missing/tied date evidence and stale identity checks.
verifiedComponents.hostChoiceContinuation: 9 focused tests pass in GREEN03; the separate native retained-form regression passes in diagnostic03. Selection stays typed, original goal unchanged, Pause/Resume preserves it.
verifiedComponents.phone: 5 actual client state/protocol tests pass via SwiftPM; iOS app including SwiftUI choices compiles. No physical phone button interaction claimed.
verifiedComponents.picker: 7 tests pass in GREEN02: 5 real native visible-file-input cases and 2 text/form regressions. Single resolved file supplied once, stale replacement/navigation/takeover rejected. GET filename/size/count observation only, not upload bytes.

notes: GREEN01 host compilation caught two Optional.flatMap inference errors; GREEN02 caught an unsupported concrete native overload; both corrected before GREEN03.

Early picker tests used a windowless fixture and then lacked the test host accessory activation policy. Corrected test setup without relaxing production focus/capture checks; RED05 then reproduced missing file-target admission.
Browser GREEN01 still rejected unlabeled file inputs. GREEN02 permits the file control type through both label gates, retaining text-editability exclusions; fixture remains unlabeled.

WebKit callback is asynchronous: one-use selection survives only its admitted click, with bounded callback wait and current task/document/session/ownership/takeover checks before and after resolution.
Current picker supports visible main-frame file inputs only. Button-triggered hidden inputs need a general bridge.
Existing WebKit profile is ephemeral and does not inherit an external browser login. Google OAuth embedded-agent policy is background evidence only; no real Drive login attempt occurred.
Native planner catalog-tool drafts remain unapplied and unverified. No change to model/runtime budgets, worker residency, default-off direct planning or installed application.
remaining: Connect catalog query/selection and multiple-choice continuation to the actual local model loop.
Support observed button-triggered file pickers and verify actual request bytes at a controlled endpoint.
Qualify the default authenticated Drive session and exact remote upload/readback, including pre-existing same-name item, Stop and duplicate prevention.
Implement and verify attachment delivery to the confirmed own email account.
